abstract: A 36-year-old woman referred to our hospital for treatment of a mediastinal tumor. Contrast computed tomography (CT) scan was revealed a 31×21×25 mm mass in the anterior mediastinum, with low contrast, clear border, and a tendency to increase. On magnetic resonance imaging( MRI) examination, the anterior mediastinal tumor showed homogeneous high signal intensity on T1-weighted images and a combination of high and low signal intensities on T2-weighted images. A benign tumor was suspected, and surgery was performed for diagnostic and therapy. Histopathology did not demonstrate malignant cells and we diagnosed the tumor as dermoid cyst. The postoperative course was uneventful and the patient was discharged on 2nd postoperative day.
abstract_ja: 当院に縦隔腫瘍の治療目的で紹介された36歳女性。造影コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)スキャンは前縦隔に31×21×25 mmの腫瘤を認め、低造影、境界明瞭、および増大傾向を呈していた。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)検査では、前縦隔腫瘍はT1強調画像で均質な高信号強度、T2強調画像で高信号と低信号強度の混合を示した。良性腫瘍が疑われ、診断および治療目的に手術が施行された。病理組織学的検査で悪性細胞は認められず、腫瘍は類皮嚢腫と診断された。術後経過は順調で患者は術後第2病日に退院した。
